name: Fearsome Reputation
body:
Word of your deeds travels fast, spreading fear far and wide.

Prerequisite: Cha 13, Intimidate 5 ranks, Persuasive

Benefit: You gain a +2 bonus to Intimidate checks and do not suffer intimidation penalties due to your size. You also perform intimidation checks simply by talking as a standard action, (without making verbal threats or displays of prowess). You must actively attempt not to intimidate people with whom you wish to communicate.
